groups.name: Near-black or tinted dark body text
groups.definition: Is the body text a dark tinted (navy, slate, green) or near-black color rather than neutral gray or pure black?

groups.name: Dark theme with light text
groups.definition: Does the page use a dark near-black body background with light/near-white text?

groups.name: Alternating full-width background bands
groups.definition: Do sections alternate between differently colored full-width background bands (white, pale, dark)?

groups.name: Warm cream or off-white page background
groups.definition: Is the page background a warm cream or off-white tint rather than pure white?

groups.name: Single accent color
groups.definition: Is one single accent color used consistently across buttons, links and labels?

groups.name: Restrained multi-hue palette
groups.definition: Is the overall palette a small, specific set of named hues (e.g. green/gold, teal, navy/amber) rather than generic colors?

groups.name: Muted secondary text color
groups.definition: Is secondary text (dates, subtitles, labels) shown in a muted gray or taupe tone?

groups.name: Solid black announcement bar
groups.definition: Is the announcement bar solid black with bold white text?

groups.name: Light header with thin border
groups.definition: Is the header white or light with a thin bottom border and dark text navigation?

groups.name: Hero diagonal gradient background
groups.definition: Does the hero use a diagonal gradient background instead of flat color?

groups.name: Score-coded metric colors
groups.definition: Are metric values color-coded by score level at uniform size?

groups.name: Green deep link text
groups.definition: Are links deep green text without chevron markers?

groups.name: Light uppercase links without underline
groups.definition: Are links light or white uppercase text without underline, except inline card links?
